aboutGame.title: What is Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME?
paragraphs: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME is a single-player psychological horror mystery adventure from Tohakusha Inc. You follow Tsumimi's livestream after Mashiro disappears, using comments, Mega Chats, gifts, and a 15-day investigation loop to uncover what happened in an abandoned village.

The game alternates daytime investigation with nighttime streams. Search results, reply chains, fan sites, and location details feed your Investigation Files; the deductions you commit to shape Tsumimi's responses and lead toward multiple endings.

modules.name: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME Endings Guide
modules.description: Compare the main ending routes and see how interventions, investigations, deductions, and final choices shape Tsumimi's fate across the 15-day story.

highlights.label: S
highlights.detail: Clean completion: answer every ritual prompt inside its window and keep the chat active to the final scene.

highlights.label: A
highlights.detail: Deviation ending: late or off-script replies produce a finale that references the earlier inconsistency.

highlights.label: B
highlights.detail: Silent ending: long chat gaps or unanswered ritual steps close the stream with minimal closure.

highlights.label: C
highlights.detail: Soft lock: the prompt repeats without new dialogue, credits, or a closing frame.

modules.name: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn the day-and-night loop, Investigation Files, comment controls, Mega Chat budgeting, and the habits that make a first playthrough smoother.

highlights.detail: Read the Investigation Files and note the open questions before each day phase begins.
Use daytime searches, reply chains, and location details to resolve keywords from the last stream.
Save from the home screen before every night stream so a bad message costs one scene, not the run.
Start with free comments, then commit a Mega Chat only when a specific deduction is ready to test.

modules.name: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME Walkthrough
modules.description: Follow the story day by day with a clear order for stream clues, daytime research, Investigation File updates, and major deductions.

highlights.detail: Treat the 15 days as repeated investigation and stream phases; finish each day's unresolved leads before night.
Watch Tsumimi's stream for names, places, contradictions, and reactions that deserve a search.
Resolve new keywords through search results, reply chains, fan sites, and location details.
Link the fragments in Investigation Files and note which conclusion each piece supports.
Test one deduction per stream with a comment first and a Mega Chat only when the answer matters.
Review the outcome, keep a clean save, and carry the remaining questions into the next day.

modules.name: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME Choices and Chat Guide
modules.description: Compare comments, Mega Chats, gifts, and silence, then plan each intervention around the clues you have and the funds you can spare.

highlights.label: Comment

highlights.label: Mega Chat
highlights.detail: A paid, highlighted message that can redirect a stream when a plain comment is ignored.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME.

items.question: What is Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME?
items.answer: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME is a single-player psychological horror mystery adventure from Tohakusha Inc. You intervene in Tsumimi's livestream while investigating Mashiro's disappearance across a 15-day story.

items.question: How long is Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME?
items.answer: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME runs for 15 in-game days, with a first playthrough of roughly 4 hours. Repeat runs can follow different deductions and reach other endings.

items.question: How do comments and Mega Chats work in Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME?
items.answer: Comments in Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME are free and useful for testing Tsumimi's reactions. Mega Chats spend limited funds to send highlighted messages that can redirect a stream when a plain comment is ignored.

items.question: Does Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME have multiple endings?
items.answer: Yes. Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME branches through interventions, investigations, deductions, and final choices, with ending achievements pointing to at least eight outcomes.

items.question: Is there a demo of Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME?
items.answer: A playable demo of Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME introduces the intervention, investigation, and deduction loop. The full release expands that structure across the complete 15-day story.

items.question: Can my PC run Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME?
items.answer: Red Chat Ritual TSUMIMI TIME requires 64-bit Windows 10, 4 GB of RAM, DirectX 11, and 4 GB of storage. The listed graphics floor is Intel UHD 620, GTX 750 Ti, or Radeon R7 260X.
